sourceSemantics.funding: _takeFunds direct ERC20 branch transfers from resolved caller, native branch requires value and wraps configured token. _releaseFunds sends output from held inventory to signed destination, _refundNative returns native overpayment. sourceSemantics.partialFill: Single nonce spent on any fill; lower amount prorates down, larger input pays more for capped maker amount. No separate amount upper-bound or min-output.

devdoc.details: This contract implements a proxy that is upgradeable by an admin. To avoid https://medium.com/nomic-labs-blog/malicious-backdoors-in-ethereum-proxies-62629adf3357[proxy selector clashing], which can potentially be used in an attack, this contract uses the https://blog.openzeppelin.com/the-transparent-proxy-pattern/[transparent proxy pattern]. This pattern implies two things that go hand in hand: 1. If any account other than the admin calls the proxy, the call will be forwarded to the implementation, even if that call matches one of the admin functions exposed by the proxy itself. 2. If the admin calls the proxy, it can access the admin functions, but its calls will never be forwarded to the implementation. If the admin tries to call a function on the implementation it will fail with an error that says "admin cannot fallback to proxy target". These properties mean that the admin account can only be used for admin actions like upgrading the proxy or changing the admin, so it's best if it's a dedicated account that is not used for anything else. This will avoid headaches due to sudden errors when trying to call a function from the proxy implementation. Our recommendation is for the dedicated account to be an instance of the {ProxyAdmin} contract. If set up this way, you should think of the `ProxyAdmin` instance as the real administrative interface of your proxy. NOTE: The real interface of this proxy is that defined in `ITransparentUpgradeableProxy`. This contract does not inherit from that interface, and instead the admin functions are implicitly implemented using a custom dispatch mechanism in `_fallback`. Consequently, the compiler will not produce an ABI for this contract. This is necessary to fully implement transparency without decoding reverts caused by selector clashes between the proxy and the implementation. WARNING: It is not recommended to extend this contract to add additional external functions. If you do so, the compiler will not check that there are no selector conflicts, due to the note above. A selector clash between any new function and the functions declared in {ITransparentUpgradeableProxy} will be resolved in favor of the new one. This could render the admin operations inaccessible, which could prevent upgradeability. Transparency may also be compromised.

grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, _address);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice  Removes Default Admin role from the address\n     * @param   _address  address to remove role from\n     */\n    function _address);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice  Checks if address has Rebalancer Admin role\n     * @param   _address  address to check\n     * @return  bool    true if address has Rebalancer Admin returns (bool) {\n        return hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, _address);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Verifies Signature in accordance of ERC1271 standard\n     * @param _hash Hash of order data\n     * @param _signature Signature of trade parameters generated from /api/rfq/firm\n     * @return bytes4   The Magic Value based on ERC1271 standard. 0x1626ba7e represents\n     * a valid signature, while 0x00000000 represents an invalid signature.\n     **/\n    function isValidSignature(bytes32 _hash, bytes calldata _signature) public view override returns (bytes4) {\n        (address signer, ) = ECDSAUpgradeable.tryRecover(_hash, _signature);\n\n        if (signer == swapSigner) {\n            return 0x1626ba7e;\n        } else {\n            return 0x00000000;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Returns the sender of the message. If the message was sent through the trusted forwarder,\n     * returns the original sender.\n     * @return address The address of the sender\n     */\n    function _msgSender() internal view virtual override returns (address) {\n        if (msg.data.length >= ORDER_SIG_LENGTH && hasRole(TRUSTED_FORWARDER_ROLE, msg.sender)) {\n            return address(bytes20(msg.data[msg.data.length - ADDRESS_LENGTH:]));\n        } else {\n            return msg.sender;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Returns the hash of the name parameter for the EIP712 domain.\n     * Overriding this function to return a constant value to save gas.\n     * @return bytes32 The hash of the name parameter\n     */\n    function _EIP712NameHash() internal view virtual override returns (bytes32) {\n        return EIP712_NAME_HASH;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Returns the hash of the version parameter for the EIP712 domain.\n     * Overriding this function to return a constant value to save gas.\n     * @return bytes32 The hash of the version parameter\n     */\n    function _EIP712VersionHash() internal view virtual override returns (bytes32) {\n        return EIP712_VERSION_HASH;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Verifies that a XChainSwap order is valid and has not been executed already.\n     * @param _order Trade parameters for cross chain swap generated from /api/rfq/firm\n     * @param _signature Signature of trade parameters generated from /api/rfq/firm\n     * @return nonceAndMeta The nonce of the swap\n     */\n    function _verifyXSwap(\n        XChainSwap calldata _order,\n        bytes calldata _signature\n    ) private returns (uint256 nonceAndMeta) {\n        bytes32 hashedStruct = keccak256(\n            abi.encode(\n                XCHAIN_SWAP_TYPEHASH,\n                _order.from,\n                _order.to,\n                _order.makerSymbol,\n                _order.makerAsset,\n                _order.takerAsset,\n                _order.makerAmount,\n                _order.takerAmount,\n                _order.nonce,\n                _order.expiry,\n                _order.destChainId,\n                _order.bridgeProvider\n            )\n        );\n        nonceAndMeta = ((uint256(_order.from) << 96) | _order.nonce);\n        _verifySwapInternal(\n            nonceAndMeta,\n            _order.expiry,\n            UtilsLibrary.bytes32ToAddress(_order.from),\n            msg.sender,\n            false,\n            hashedStruct,\n            _signature\n        );\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Handles the exchange of assets based on swap type and\n     * if the assets are ERC-20's or native tokens. Transfer assets in on the source chain\n     * and sends a cross chain message to release assets on the destination chain\n     * @param _order Trade parameters for cross chain swap generated from /api/rfq/firm\n     * @param _nonceAndMeta Nonce of swap\n     **/\n    function _executeXSwap(XChainSwap calldata _order, uint256 _nonceAndMeta) private {\n        SwapData memory swapData = SwapData({\n            nonceAndMeta: _nonceAndMeta,\n            taker: UtilsLibrary.bytes32ToAddress(_order.from),\n            destTrader: _order.to,\n            destChainId: _order.destChainId,\n            srcAsset: UtilsLibrary.bytes32ToAddress(_order.takerAsset),\n            destAsset: _order.makerAsset,\n            srcAmount: _order.takerAmount,\n            destAmount: _order.makerAmount,\n            msgSender: msg.sender,\n            isDirect: true\n        });\n        _executeSwapInternal(swapData, false);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Verifies that an order is valid and has not been executed already.\n     * @param _order Trade parameters for swap generated from /api/rfq/firm\n     * @param _signature Signature of trade parameters generated from /api/rfq/firm\n     * @return address The address where the funds will be transferred. It is an Aggregator address if\n     * the address in the nonceAndMeta matches the msg.sender\n     **/\n    function _verifyOrder(Order calldata _order, bytes calldata _signature, address _sender) private returns (address) {\n        address destTrader = address(uint160(_order.nonceAndMeta >> 96));\n\n        bytes32 hashedStruct = keccak256(\n            abi.encode(\n                ORDER_TYPEHASH,\n                _order.nonceAndMeta,\n                _order.expiry,\n                _order.makerAsset,\n                _order.takerAsset,\n                _order.maker,\n                _order.taker,\n                _order.makerAmount,\n                _order.takerAmount\n            )\n        );\n        _verifySwapInternal(\n            _order.nonceAndMeta,\n            uint32(_order.expiry),\n            _order.taker,\n            _sender,\n            destTrader == _sender,\n            hashedStruct,\n            _signature\n        );\n        return destTrader;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Handles the exchange of assets based on swap type and\n     * if the assets are ERC-20's or native tokens.\n     * @param _order Trade parameters for swap generated from /api/rfq/firm\n     * @param _makerAmount The proper makerAmount for the trade\n     * @param _takerAmount The proper takerAmount for the trade\n     * @param _destTrader The address to transfer funds to\n     **/\n    function _executeOrder(\n        Order calldata _order,\n        uint256 _makerAmount,\n        uint256 _takerAmount,\n        address _destTrader,\n        address _sender\n    ) private {\n        uint8 slipInfo = uint8(_order.nonceAndMeta >> 88);\n        if (slipInfo > SLIP_BPS_MASK) {\n            _makerAmount = _slipQuote(slipInfo, _order.expiry, _makerAmount);\n        }\n        SwapData memory swapData = SwapData({\n            nonceAndMeta: _order.nonceAndMeta,\n            taker: _order.taker,\n            destTrader: UtilsLibrary.addressToBytes32(_destTrader),\n            destChainId: uint32(block.chainid),\n            srcAsset: _order.takerAsset,\n            destAsset: UtilsLibrary.addressToBytes32(_order.makerAsset),\n            srcAmount: _takerAmount,\n            destAmount: _makerAmount,\n            msgSender: _sender,\n            isDirect: _sender == msg.sender\n        });\n        _executeSwapInternal(swapData, true);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Verifies that a swap has a valid signature, nonce and expiry\n     * @param _nonceAndMeta Nonce of swap\n     * @param _expiry Expiry of swap\n     * @param _taker Address of originating user\n     * @param _isAggregator True if swap initiated by contract i.e. aggregator\n     * @param _hashedStruct Hashed swap struct, required for signature verification\n     * @param _signature Signature of swap\n     *\n     */\n    function _verifySwapInternal(\n        uint256 _nonceAndMeta,\n        uint256 _expiry,\n        address _taker,\n        address _sender,\n        bool _isAggregator,\n        bytes32 _hashedStruct,\n        bytes calldata _signature\n    ) private {\n        require(block.timestamp <= _expiry, \"RF-QE-02\");\n        require(_taker == _sender || _isAggregator, \"RF-IMS-01\");\n\n        uint256 bucket = _nonceAndMeta >> 8;\n        uint256 mask = 1 << (_nonceAndMeta & 0xff);\n        uint256 bitmap = completedSwaps[bucket];\n\n        require(bitmap & mask == 0, \"RF-IN-01\");\n        require(isValidSignature(_hashTypedDataV4(_hashedStruct), _signature) == 0x1626ba7e, \"RF-IS-01\");\n\n        completedSwaps[bucket] = bitmap | mask;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Pulls funds for a swap from the msg.sender\n     * @param _swapData Struct containing all information for executing a swap\n     * @param _wrappedInfo Struct containing wrapped token info\n     */\n    function _takeFunds(SwapData memory _swapData, WrappedInfo memory _wrappedInfo) private {\n        if (_swapData.srcAsset == address(0)) {\n            require(msg.value >= _swapData.srcAmount, \"RF-IMV-01\");\n            if (_wrappedInfo.keepWrapped) {\n                _wrappedInfo.wrappedNative.deposit{value: _swapData.srcAmount}();\n            }\n            return;\n        }\n\n        require(msg.value == 0, \"RF-NSIV-01\");\n\n        if (_swapData.isDirect) {\n            IERC20Upgradeable(_swapData.srcAsset).safeTransferFrom(\n                _swapData.msgSender,\n                address(this),\n                _swapData.srcAmount\n            );\n        }\n        if (!_wrappedInfo.keepWrapped && _swapData.srcAsset == address(_wrappedInfo.wrappedNative)) {\n            _wrappedInfo.wrappedNative.withdraw(_swapData.srcAmount);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Release funds for a swap to the destTrader\n     * @param _swapData Struct containing all information for executing a swap\n     * @param _wrappedInfo Struct containing wrapped token info\n     */\n    function _releaseFunds(SwapData memory _swapData, WrappedInfo memory _wrappedInfo) private {\n        address destAsset = UtilsLibrary.bytes32ToAddress(_swapData.destAsset);\n        address destTrader = UtilsLibrary.bytes32ToAddress(_swapData.destTrader);\n\n        if (destAsset == address(0)) {\n            if (_wrappedInfo.keepWrapped) {\n                _wrappedInfo.wrappedNative.withdraw(_swapData.destAmount);\n            }\n            (bool success, ) = payable(destTrader).call{value: _swapData.destAmount}(\"\");\n            require(success, \"RF-TF-01\");\n        } else {\n            if (!_wrappedInfo.keepWrapped && destAsset == address(_wrappedInfo.wrappedNative)) {\n                _wrappedInfo.wrappedNative.deposit{value: _swapData.destAmount}();\n            }\n            IERC20Upgradeable(destAsset).safeTransfer(destTrader, _swapData.destAmount);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Refunds remaining native token to the msg.sender\n     * @param _swapData Struct containing all information for executing a swap\n     */\n    function _refundNative(SwapData memory _swapData) private {\n        if (_swapData.srcAsset == address(0) && msg.value > _swapData.srcAmount) {\n            (bool success, ) = payable(_swapData.msgSender).call{value: msg.value - _swapData.srcAmount}(\"\");\n            require(success, \"RF-TF-02\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Executes a swap by taking funds from the msg.sender and if the swap is not cross chain\n     * funds are released to the destTrader. Emits SwapExecuted event upon completion.\n     * @param _swapData Struct containing all information for executing a swap\n     * @param isNotXChain True if the swap is not cross chain\n     */\n    function _executeSwapInternal(SwapData memory _swapData, bool isNotXChain) private {\n        WrappedInfo memory _wrappedInfo;\n        if (_swapData.isDirect) {\n            _wrappedInfo = wrappedInfo;\n        }\n\n        _takeFunds(_swapData, _wrappedInfo);\n        if (isNotXChain) {\n            _releaseFunds(_swapData, _wrappedInfo);\n            _refundNative(_swapData);\n        }\n\n        emit SwapExecuted(\n            _swapData.nonceAndMeta,\n            _swapData.taker,\n            _swapData.destTrader,\n            _swapData.destChainId,\n            _swapData.srcAsset,\n            _swapData.destAsset,\n            _swapData.srcAmount,\n            _swapData.destAmount\n        );\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Sends a cross chain message to PortfolioBridge containing the destination token amount,\n     * symbol and trader. Sends remaining native token as gas fee for cross chain message. Refund for\n     * gas fee is handled in PortfolioBridge.\n     * @param _order Trade parameters for cross chain swap generated from /api/rfq/firm\n     */\n    function _sendCrossChainTrade(XChainSwap calldata _order) private {\n        bytes18 customdata = bytes18(uint144(_order.nonce));\n        uint256 nativeAmount = _order.takerAsset == bytes32(0) ? _order.takerAmount : 0;\n        uint256 gasFee = msg.value - nativeAmount;\n        // Nonce to be assigned in PBridge\n        portfolioBridge.sendXChainMessage{value: gasFee}(\n            _order.destChainId,\n            _order.bridgeProvider,\n            IPortfolio.XFER(\n                0,\n                IPortfolio.Tx.CCTRADE,\n                _order.to,\n                _order.makerSymbol,\n                _order.makerAmount,\n                block.timestamp,\n                customdata\n            ),\n            UtilsLibrary.bytes32ToAddress(_order.from)\n        );\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Adds unfulfilled swaps (due to lack of inventory) to a queue\n     * @param _trader Trader address to transfer to\n     * @param _symbol Token symbol to transfer\n     * @param _quantity Quantity of token to transfer\n     * @param _nonceAndMeta Nonce of the swap\n     */\n    function _addToSwapQueue(address _trader, bytes32 _symbol, uint256 _quantity, uint256 _nonceAndMeta) private {\n        PendingSwap memory pendingSwap = PendingSwap({trader: _trader, symbol: _symbol, quantity: _quantity});\n        swapQueue[_nonceAndMeta] = pendingSwap;\n        emit SwapQueue(\"ADDED\", _nonceAndMeta, pendingSwap);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice  Using the bridge message, releases the remaining swap funds to the trader on the\n     * destination chain and sets nonce to used. If not enough inventory swap is added to queue.\n     * @param   _trader  Address of the trader\n     * @param   _symbol  Symbol of the token\n     * @param   _quantity  Amount of token to be withdrawn\n     * @param   _nonceAndMeta  Nonce of the swap\n     */\n    function _processXFerPayloadInternal(\n        address _trader,\n        bytes32 _symbol,\n        uint256 _quantity,\n        uint256 _nonceAndMeta\n    ) private returns (bool) {\n        uint256 bucket = _nonceAndMeta >> 8;\n        uint256 mask = 1 << (_nonceAndMeta & 0xff);\n        require(completedSwaps[bucket] & mask == 0, \"RF-IN-02\");\n\n        bool success = false;\n        if (_symbol == IPortfolio(portfolioMain).getNative()) {\n            // Send native\n            // solhint-disable-next-line avoid-low-level-calls\n            (success, ) = _trader.call{value: _quantity}(\"\");\n        } else {\n            IERC20Upgradeable token = IPortfolioMain(portfolioMain).getToken(_symbol);\n            require(address(token) != address(0), \"RF-DTNF-01\");\n\n            (bool erc20Success, bytes memory data) = address(token).call(\n                abi.encodeWithSelector(token.transfer.selector, _trader, _quantity)\n            );\n            success = (erc20Success && (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data, (bool))));\n        }\n        if (!success) {\n            _addToSwapQueue(_trader, _symbol, _quantity, _nonceAndMeta);\n            return false;\n        }\n        completedSwaps[bucket] |= mask;\n        emit XChainFinalized(_nonceAndMeta, _trader, _symbol, _quantity, block.timestamp);\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice  Slips the quote based on the slippage points and expiry\n     * @param   slipInfo  Slip info bitmap\n     * @param   expiry    Expiry of the quote\n     * @param   amount    Original maker amount\n     * @return  uint256   Slipped maker amount\n     */\n    function _slipQuote(uint8 slipInfo, uint128 expiry, uint256 amount) private view returns (uint256) {\n        uint8 slipBpsKey = (slipInfo & SLIP_BPS_MASK);\n\n        // slipInfo = always slip (1) | quote ttl (4) | slippage bps (3)\n        if (slipInfo & 0x80 != 0) {\n            return (amount * (SLIP_PRECISION - slippagePoints[slipBpsKey])) / SLIP_PRECISION;\n        }\n\n        uint256 quoteTtl = 5 * (slipInfo >> SLIP_BPS_SHIFT);\n        uint256 expiryMinusTtl = expiry - quoteTtl;\n        // If block.timestamp < expiry - quoteTtl, return the original amount\n        if (block.timestamp <= expiryMinusTtl) {\n            return amount;\n        }\n\n        uint256 activeQuoteTs = block.timestamp - expiryMinusTtl;\n        uint256 slipBps = slippagePoints[(activeQuoteTs << SLIP_BPS_SHIFT) | slipBpsKey];\n        // if set to 0.01 bps treat as no slippage\n        if (slipBps == 1) {\n            return amount;\n        }\n        // if point not set, use default for curve\n        if (slipBps == 0) {\n            slipBps = slippagePoints[slipBpsKey];\n        }\n        return (amount * (SLIP_PRECISION - slipBps)) / SLIP_PRECISION;\n    }\n\n    // solhint-disable-next-line payable-fallback\n    fallback() external {\n        revert(\"RF-NFUN-01\");\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x1718f7610115d2e12623ac637f12c3fff1563429ba523ae7d3101004c4408d9a","license":"BUSL-1.1"},"contracts/interfaces/IERC1271.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: LICENSE.txt file for licensing info.\n// Copyright 2022 Dexalot.\n\ninterface ITradePairs {\n    /**\n     * @notice  Order is the data structure defining an order on Dexalot.\n     * @dev     If there are multiple partial fills, the new partial fill `price * quantity`\n     * is added to the current value in `totalamount`. Average execution price can be\n     * quickly calculated by `totalamount / quantityfilled` regardless of the number of\n     * partial fills at different prices \\\n     * `totalFee` is always in terms of received(incoming) currency. ie. if Buy ALOT/AVAX,\n     * fee is paid in ALOT, if Sell ALOT/AVAX, fee is paid in AVAX\n     * @param   id  unique order id assigned by the contract (immutable)\n     * @param   clientOrderId  client order id given by the sender of the order as a reference (immutable)\n     * @param   tradePairId  client order id given by the sender of the order as a reference (immutable)\n     * @param   price  price of the order entered by the trader. (0 if market order) (immutable)\n     * @param   totalAmount  cumulative amount in quote currency: `price* quantityfilled`\n     * @param   quantity  order quantity (immutable)\n     * @param   quantityFilled  cumulative quantity filled\n     * @param   totalFee cumulative fee paid for the order\n     * @param   traderaddress`  traders’s wallet (immutable)\n     * @param   side  Order side  See #Side (immutable)\n     * @param   type1  Order Type1  See #Type1 (immutable)\n     * @param   type2  Order Type2  See #Type2 (immutable)\n     * @param   status  Order Status  See #Status\n     * @param   updateBlock  Block No the order was last changed\n     * @param   createBlock  Block No the order was created\n     */\n    struct Order {\n        bytes32 id;\n        bytes32 clientOrderId;\n        bytes32 tradePairId;\n        uint256 price;\n        uint256 totalAmount;\n        uint256 quantity;\n        uint256 quantityFilled;\n        uint256 totalFee;\n        address traderaddress; //20\n        Side side; //1\n        Type1 type1; //1\n        Type2 type2; //1\n        Status status; //1\n        uint32 updateBlock; //4\n        uint32 createBlock; //4\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice  Data structure to send a new order to Dexalot.\n     * @dev     Use this struct to send ListOrders\n     * @param   clientOrderId  client order id given by the sender of the order as a reference\n     * @param   tradePairId  client order id given by the sender of the order as a reference\n     * @param   price  price of the order entered by the trader. (0 if market order)\n     * @param   quantity  order quantity\n     * @param   traderaddress`  traders’s wallet\n     * @param   side  Order side  See #Side\n     * @param   type1  Order Type1  See #Type1\n     * @param   type2  Order Type2  See #Type2\n     * @param   stp  Self Trade Prevention Mode. See #STP\n     */\n    struct NewOrder {\n        bytes32 clientOrderId;\n        bytes32 tradePairId;\n        uint256 price;\n        uint256 quantity;\n        address traderaddress;\n        Side side;\n        Type1 type1;\n        Type2 type2;\n        STP stp;\n    }\n    /**\n     * @notice  TradePair is the data structure defining a trading pair on Dexalot.\n     * @param   baseSymbol  symbol of the base asset\n     * @param   quoteSymbol  symbol of the quote asset\n     * @param   buyBookId  buy book id for the trading pair\n     * @param   sellBookId  sell book id for the trading pair\n     * @param   minTradeAmount  minimum trade amount as a taker. Less than or equal to the minPostAmount\n     * @param   maxTradeAmount  maximum trade amount\n     * @param   auctionPrice  price during an auction\n     * @param   auctionMode  current auction mode of the trading pair\n     * @param   makerRate fee rate for a maker order for the trading pair\n     * @param   takerRate fee rate for taker order for the trading pair\n     * @param   baseDecimals  evm decimals of the base asset\n     * @param   baseDisplayDecimals  display decimals of the base Asset. Quantity increment\n     * @param   quoteDecimals  evm decimals of the quote asset\n     * @param   quoteDisplayDecimals  display decimals of the quote Asset. Price increment\n     * @param   allowedSlippagePercent allowed slippage percentage for the trading pair\n     * @param   addOrderPaused true/false pause state for adding orders on the trading pair\n     * @param   pairPaused true/false pause state of the trading pair as a whole\n     * @param   postOnly true/false  Post Only orders type2 = PO allowed when true\n     * @param   minPostAmount minimum Trade Amount that can be posted to the orderbook\n     */\n    struct TradePair {\n        bytes32 baseSymbol;\n        bytes32 quoteSymbol;\n        bytes32 buyBookId;\n        bytes32 sellBookId;\n        uint256 minTradeAmount;\n        uint256 maxTradeAmount;\n        uint256 auctionPrice;\n        AuctionMode auctionMode;\n        uint8 makerRate;\n        uint8 takerRate;\n        uint8 baseDecimals;\n        uint8 baseDisplayDecimals;\n        uint8 quoteDecimals;\n        uint8 quoteDisplayDecimals;\n        uint8 allowedSlippagePercent;\n        bool addOrderPaused;\n        bool pairPaused;\n        bool postOnly;\n        uint256 minPostAmount;\n    }\n\n    function pause() external;\n\n    function unpause() external;\n\n    function pauseTradePair(bytes32 _tradePairId, bool _tradePairPause) external;\n\n    function pauseAddOrder(bytes32 _tradePairId, bool _addOrderPause) external;\n\n    function postOnly(bytes32 _tradePairId, bool _postOnly) external;\n\n    function addTradePair(\n        bytes32 _tradePairId,\n        IPortfolio.TokenDetails calldata _baseTokenDetails,\n        uint8 _baseDisplayDecimals,\n        IPortfolio.TokenDetails calldata _quoteTokenDetails,\n        uint8 _quoteDisplayDecimals,\n        uint256 _minTradeAmount,\n        uint256 _maxTradeAmount,\n        AuctionMode _mode\n    ) external;\n\n    function removeTradePair(bytes32 _tradePairId) external;\n\n    function getTradePairs() external view returns (bytes32[] memory);\n\n    function setMinPostAmount(bytes32 _tradePairId, uint256 _minPostAmount) external;\n\n    function setMinTradeAmount(bytes32 _tradePairId, uint256 _minTradeAmount) external;\n\n    function setMaxTradeAmount(bytes32 _tradePairId, uint256 _maxTradeAmount) external;\n\n    function addOrderType(bytes32 _tradePairId, Type1 _type) external;\n\n    function removeOrderType(bytes32 _tradePairId, Type1 _type) external;\n\n    function setDisplayDecimals(bytes32 _tradePairId, uint8 _displayDecimals, bool _isBase) external;\n\n    function getTradePair(bytes32 _tradePairId) external view returns (TradePair memory);\n\n    function updateRate(bytes32 _tradePairId, uint8 _rate, RateType _rateType) external;\n\n    function setAllowedSlippagePercent(bytes32 _tradePairId, uint8 _allowedSlippagePercent) external;\n\n    function getNBook(\n        bytes32 _tradePairId,\n        Side _side,\n        uint256 _nPrice,\n        uint256 _nOrder,\n        uint256 _lastPrice,\n        bytes32 _lastOrder\n    ) external view returns (uint256[] memory, uint256[] memory, uint256, bytes32);\n\n    function getOrder(bytes32 _orderId) external view returns (Order memory);\n\n    function getOrderByClientOrderId(address _trader, bytes32 _clientOrderId) external view returns (Order memory);\n\n    function addNewOrder(NewOrder calldata _order) external;\n\n    function addOrderList(NewOrder[] calldata _orders) external;\n\n    function cancelAddList(bytes32[] calldata _orderIdsToCancel, NewOrder[] calldata _orders) external;\n\n    function cancelAddListByClientIds(bytes32[] calldata _clientIdsToCancel, NewOrder[] calldata _orders) external;\n\n    function cancelOrderByClientId(bytes32 _clientOrderId) external;\n\n    function cancelOrderListByClientIds(bytes32[] calldata _clientOrderIds) external view returns (uint256);\n\n    /**\n     * @notice  Order Side\n     * @dev     0: BUY    – BUY \\\n     * 1: SELL   – SELL\n     */\n    enum Side {\n        BUY,\n        SELL\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice  Order Type1\n     * @dev     Type1 = LIMIT is always allowed. MARKET is enabled pair by pair basis based on liquidity. \\\n     * 0: MARKET – Order will immediately match with the best Bid/Ask  \\\n     * 1: LIMIT  – Order that may execute at limit price or better at the order entry. The remaining quantity\n     * will be entered in the order book\\\n     * 2: STOP   –  For future use \\\n     * 3: STOPLIMIT  –  For future use \\\n     */\n    enum Type1 {\n        MARKET,\n        LIMIT,\n        STOP,\n        STOPLIMIT\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice  Order Status\n     * @dev     And order automatically gets the NEW status once it is committed to the blockchain \\\n     * 0: NEW      – Order is in the orderbook with no trades/executions \\\n     * 1: REJECTED – Order is rejected. Currently used addLimitOrderList to notify when an order from the list is\n     * rejected instead of reverting the entire order list \\\n     * 2: PARTIAL  – Order filled partially and it remains in the orderbook until FILLED/CANCELED \\\n     * 3: FILLED   – Order filled fully and removed from the orderbook \\\n     * 4: CANCELED – Order canceled and removed from the orderbook. PARTIAL before CANCELED is allowed \\\n     * 5: EXPIRED  – For future use \\\n     * 6: KILLED   – For future use \\\n     * 7: CANCEL_REJECT   – Cancel Request Rejected with reason code \\\n     */\n    enum Status {\n        NEW,\n        REJECTED,\n        PARTIAL,\n        FILLED,\n        CANCELED,\n        EXPIRED,\n        KILLED,\n        CANCEL_REJECT\n    }\n    /**\n     * @notice  Rate Type\n     * @dev     Maker Rates are typically lower than taker rates \\\n     * 0: MAKER   – MAKER \\\n     * 1: TAKER   – TAKER\n     */\n    enum RateType {\n        MAKER,\n        TAKER\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice  Self Trade Prevention\n     * @dev     STP Mode when both maker and taker orders are from the same traderaddress\n     * 0: CANCELTAKER   – cancel Taker Order\n     * 1: CANCELMAKER   – cancel Maker Order\n     * 2: CANCELBOTH    – cancel both Maker & Taker Orders\n     * 3: NONE          – Self Trade allowed\n     */\n    enum STP {\n        CANCELTAKER,\n        CANCELMAKER,\n        CANCELBOTH,\n        NONE\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice  Order Type2 to be used in conjunction with when Type1= LIMIT\n     * @dev     GTC is the default Type2 \\\n     * 0: GTC  – Good Till Cancel \\\n     * 1: FOK  – Fill or Kill. The order will either get an immediate FILLED status or be reverted with *T-FOKF-01*.\n     * If reverted, no transaction is committed to the blockchain) \\\n     * 2: IOC  – Immediate or Cancel. The order will either get a PARTIAL followed by an automatic CANCELED\n     * or a FILLED. If PARTIAL, the remaining will not be entered into the orderbook) \\\n     * 3: PO   – Post Only. The order will either be entered into the orderbook without any fills or will be REJECTED\n     * with code = T-T2PO-01)\n     */\n    enum Type2 {\n        GTC,\n        FOK,\n        IOC,\n        PO\n    }\n    /**\n     * @notice  Auction Mode of a token\n     * @dev     Only the baseToken of a TradePair can be in an auction mode other than OFF\n     * When a token is in auction, it can not be withdrawn or transfeered as a Protection againt rogue AMM Pools\n     * popping up during auction and distorting the fair auction price. \\\n     * Auction tokens can only be deposited by the contracts in the addTrustedContracts list. They are currently\n     * Avalaunch and Dexalot TokenVesting contracts. These contracts allow the deposits to Dexalot Discovery Auction\n     * before TGE\n     * ***Transitions ***\n     * AUCTION_ADMIN enters the tradepair in PAUSED mode \\\n     * Changes it to OPEN at pre-announced auction start date/time \\\n     * Changes it to CLOSING at pre-announced Randomized Auction Closing Sequence date/time\n     * ExchangeMain.flipCoin() are called for the randomization \\\n     * Changes it to MATCHING when the flipCoin condition is satisfied. And proceeds with setting the auction Price\n     * and ExchangeSub.matchAuctionOrders until all the crossed orders are matched and removed from the orderbook \\\n     * Changes it to LIVETRADING if pre-announced token release date/time is NOT reached, so regular trading can start\n     * without allowing tokens to be retrieved/transferred  \\\n     * Changes it to OFF when the pre-announced token release time is reached. Regular trading in effect and tokens\n     * can be withdrawn or transferred \\\n     * 0: OFF  – Used for the Regular Listing of a token. Default \\\n     * 1: LIVETRADING  – Token is in auction. Live trading in effect but tokens can't be withdrawn or transferred \\\n     * 2: OPEN  – Ongoing auction. Orders can be entered/cancelled freely. Orders will not match. \\\n     * 3: CLOSING   – Randomized Auction Closing Sequence before the auction is closed, new orders/cancels allowed\n     * but auction can close at any time \\\n     * 4: PAUSED   – Auction paused, no new orders/cancels allowed \\\n     * 5: MATCHING   – Auction closed. Final Auction Price is determined and set. No new orders/cancels allowed.\n     * orders matching starts \\\n     * 6: RESTRICTED   – Functionality Reserved for future use \\\n     */\n    enum AuctionMode {\n        OFF,\n        LIVETRADING,\n        OPEN,\n        CLOSING,\n        PAUSED,\n        MATCHING,\n        RESTRICTED\n    }\n\n    event NewTradePair(\n        uint8 version,\n        bytes32 pair,\n        uint8 basedisplaydecimals,\n        uint8 quotedisplaydecimals,\n        uint256 mintradeamount,\n        uint256 maxtradeamount\n    );\n\n    /**\n     * @notice  Emits a given order's latest state\n     * @dev     If there are multiple partial fills, the new partial fill `price * quantity`\n     * is added to the current value in `totalAmount`. Average execution price can be\n     * quickly calculated by `totalAmount / quantityFilled` regardless of the number of\n     * partial fills at different prices \\\n     * `totalFee` is always in terms of received(incoming) currency. ie. if Buy ALOT/AVAX,\n     * fee is paid in ALOT, if Sell ALOT/AVAX , fee is paid in AVAX \\\n     * **Note**: The execution price will always be equal or better than the Order price.\n     * @param   version  event version\n     * @param   traderaddress  traders’s wallet (immutable)\n     * @param   pair  traded pair. ie. ALOT/AVAX in bytes32 (immutable)\n     * @param   order  See ITradePairs.Order Struct (Order details)\n     * @param   previousUpdateBlock Previous Block No the order was last changed/created\n     * @param   code reason code when order has CANCELED(due to self trade protection), REJECTED or CANCEL_REJECT status\n     */\n    event OrderStatusChanged(\n        uint8 version,\n        address indexed traderaddress,\n        bytes32 indexed pair,\n        Order order,\n        uint32 previousUpdateBlock,\n        bytes32 code\n    );\n\n    /**\n     * @notice  Emits the Executed/Trade Event showing\n     * @dev     The side of the taker order can be used to identify\n     * the fee unit. If takerSide = 1, then the fee is paid by the maker in base\n     * currency and the fee paid by the taker in quote currency. ALOT/AVAX in bytes32\n     * @param   price  executed price\n     * @param   quantity  executed quantity\n     * @param   makerOrder  maker Order id\n     * @param   takerOrder  taker Order id\n     * @param   feeMaker  fee paid by maker\n     * @param   feeTaker  fee paid by taker\n     * @param   takerSide  Side of the taker order. 0 - BUY, 1- SELL\n     * @param   execId  unique trade id Side takerSide,\n        uint256 execId,\n        address indexed addressMaker,\n        address indexed addressTaker\n    );\n    event ParameterUpdated(uint8 version, bytes32 indexed pair, string param, uint256 oldValue, uint256 _quoteSymbol  quote Symbol\n     * @param   _baseSymbol  base Symbol\n     * @param   _baseDecimals  base Token decimals of the trading pair\n     * @param   _price  price\n     * @param   _quantity  quantity\n     * @return  outSymbol  outgoing token symbol\n     * @return  outAmount outgoing Amount\n     */\n\n    function getOutgoingDetails(\n        ITradePairs.Side _orderSide,\n outAmount) {\n        if (_orderSide == ITradePairs.Side.BUY) {\n            outSymbol = _quoteSymbol;\n            outAmount = getQuoteAmount(_baseDecimals, _price, _quantity);\n        } else {\n            outSymbol = _baseSymbol;\n            outAmount = _quantity;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice  Checks if a tradePair is in auction and if matching is not allowed in the orderbook.\n     * @param   _mode  Auction Mode\n     * @return  bool  true/false\n     */\n    function matchingAllowed(ITradePairs.AuctionMode _mode) internal pure returns (bool) {\n        return _mode == ITradePairs.AuctionMode.OFF || _mode == ITradePairs.AuctionMode.LIVETRADING;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice  Checks if the auction is in a restricted state.\n     * @param   _mode  Auction Mode\n     * @return  bool  true if Auction is in restricted mode\n     */\n    function isAuctionRestricted(ITradePairs.AuctionMode _mode) internal pure returns (bool) {\n        return _mode == ITradePairs.AuctionMode.RESTRICTED || _mode == ITradePairs.AuctionMode.CLOSING;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice  Checks if the order is cancelable.\n     * @dev     For an order _quantityFilled < _quantity and its status should be PARTIAL or NEW\n                to be eligible for cancelation\n     * @param   _quantity  quantity of the order\n     * @param   _quantityFilled  quantityFilled of the order\n     * @param   _orderStatus  status of the order\n     * @return  bool  true if cancelable\n     */\n    function canCancel(\n        uint256 _quantity,\n        uint256 _quantityFilled,\n        ITradePairs.Status _orderStatus\n    ) internal pure returns (bool) {\n        return (_quantityFilled < _quantity &&\n            (_orderStatus == ITradePairs.Status.PARTIAL || _orderStatus == ITradePairs.Status.NEW));\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice  Round down a unit256 value.  Used for the fees to avoid dust.\n     * @param   _a  number to round down\n     * @param   _m  number of digits from the right to round down\n     * @return  uint256  rounded down value\n     */\n    function floor(uint256 _a, uint256 _m) internal pure returns (uint256) {\n        return (_a / 10 ** _m) * 10 ** _m;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice  Returns the minimum of the two uint256 (_a <= _b ? _a : _b);\n    }\n\n    function max(uint256 _a, uint256 _b) internal pure returns (uint256) {\n        return (_a >= _b ? _a : _b);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice  Converts a bytes32 internal pure returns (string memory) {\n        uint8 i = 0;\n        while (i < 32 && _bytes32[i] != 0) {\n            ++i;\n        }\n        bytes memory bytesArray = new bytes(i);\n        for (i = 0; i < 32 && _bytes32[i] != 0; ++i) {\n            bytesArray[i] = _bytes32[i];\n        }\n        return string(bytesArray);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice  Converts a string to a bytes32 returns (bytes32 result) {\n        bytes memory tempEmptyStringTest = bytes(_string);\n        if (tempEmptyStringTest.length == 0) {\n            return 0x0;\n        }\n        // solhint-disable-next-line no-inline-assembly\n        assembly {\n            result := mload(add(_string, 32))\n        }\n    }\n\n    function addressToBytes32(address _addr) internal pure returns devdoc.details: After getting a firm quote from our off chain RFQ API, call the simpleSwap() function with the quote. This will execute a swap, exchanging the taker asset (asset you provide) with the maker asset (asset we provide). In times of high volatility, the API may adjust the expiry of your quote. The Api may also add slippage to all orders for a particular tradepair during times of high volatility. Monitor the SwapExpired event to verify if a swap has been adjusted. Adjusting the quote is rare, and only resorted to in periods of high volatility for quotes that do not properly represent the liquidity of the Dexalot L1. IThis contract also supports a new cross chain swap flow(originally referred to as GUN Flow) where any user can buy GUN token from any network with a single click. This is particularly beneficial for Avalanche L1s that have certain token restrictions. For example Gunzilla prohibits ERC20s just like Dexalat L1 and they don't allow their gas token in any network but in Gunzilla. When Buying GUN from Avalanche(or Arb,...) with counter token USDC, USDC is kept in MainnetRFQ(Avax) and GUN is deposited to the buyer's wallet via MainnetRFQ(Gun). The flow is : \ MainnetRFQ(Avax) => PortfolioBridgeMain(Avax) => ICM => PortfolioBridgeMain(Gun) => MainnetRFQ(Gun) \ When Selling GUN from Gunzilla with counter token USDC. GUN is kept in MainnetRFQ(Gun) and USDC is deposited to the buyer's wallet via MainnetRFQ(Avax) The flow is : \ MainnetRFQ(Gun) => PortfolioBridgeMain(Gun) => ICM => PortfolioBridgeMain(Avax) => MainnetRFQ(Avax) \ Similarly a Cross Chain Swaps Betwen Avalanche & Arb would work as follows exchanging AVAX & ETH MainnetRFQ(Avax) => PortfolioBridgeMain(Avax) => LayerZero => PortfolioBridgeMain(Arb) => MainnetRFQ(Arb) \ MainnetRFQ(Arb) => PortfolioBridgeMain(Arb) => LayerZero => PortfolioBridgeMain(Avax) => MainnetRFQ(Avax) \

# Dexalot Smart Contracts

## *Please read the entire README before running any commands.*

## Set up the development environment

- Install the latest version of VS Code
- Install the latest version of git version control
- Install Node.js version 18.16.0
## Get the code

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Dexalot/contracts.git
```

## Project setup

Install hardhat packages

```sh
yarn install
```

Install foundry packages, if foundry not installed please view installation steps [here](https://book.getfoundry.sh/getting-started/installation)

```sh
forge install
```

## Hardhat Environment Tests

### Compile and start the Hardhat environment on Terminal 1

This script creates a Hardhat Development blockchain that you can interact with.

```sh
yarn hh-start-clean
```

### Run the individual tests on the Hardhat environment on Terminal 2

The `run_tests.sh` script runs one or more tests fitting a pattern on the Hardhat Development blockchain.  You need to have a running ```yarn hh-start-clean``` process first. You can use it as follows from the project's root folder:

```sh
./test/run_test.sh            [run each test with pauses or all in one go]
./test/run_test.sh Portfolio  [run all tests with a Portfolio prefix]
```

The above commands would work in a unix-like shell environment.  On other platforms you can call individual tests as below:

```sh
npx hardhat test test/<TEST_FILE_NAME>.ts

Example:
npx hardhat test test/TestAirdrop.ts
```

Available tests are as follows:

```sh
npx hardhat  test ./test/TestAirdrop.ts
npx hardhat  test ./test/TestAuction.ts
npx hardhat  test ./test/TestAuctionPerfectMatch.ts

```

The scripts `TestDexalot.ts`, `TestAuction.ts` and `TestGetNBook.ts` run a set of simulated trades to test the whole system.  Before running any simulator a second time you need to stop a running ```yarn hh-start-clean``` script and rerun ```yarn hh-start-clean``` to reset all the counters.

### Solidity Coverage

The hardhat environment has the solidity-coverage plugin installed during the initial `yarn install` command.

You can run it as below to get a Solidity coverage report.

```sh
yarn hh-coverage
```

Please note the full coverage run will take 10-20 minutes depending on the speed of your computer.

### Supported Chains

Dexalot is a CLOB exchange which operates fully on-chain on its' own L1. Deposits to Dexalot L1 can be done using the Portfolio contracts deployed on multiple chains.
Currently supported chains:
* Arbitrum
* Avalanche C-Chain
* Base
* BNB Smart Chain (BSC)
* Ethereum
* Gunzilla

Dexalot team built a documentation site to serve the developer community.  Please visit at
[Dexalot Knowledge Hub @ https://docs.dexalot.com](https://docs.dexalot.com) to
learn more about the novel dual-chain app.

Signed Endpoints

The following endpoints are used to fetch data for a specific trading address. Such as getting orders or balances of an address. In order to perform these requests you will have to provide a signature to prove you own the address being queried.

You have to sign "dexalot" message and provide the signature in x-signature header along with your Signed Endpoint requests.

Typescript/Javascript Example: Generating the signature using ethers library:

    const wallet = new ethers.Wallet(PRIV_KEY);
    const signature = await wallet.signMessage("dexalot");

    // Set your request header like below
    // e.g. 0xAf67D600efb58d189d6129BC17AEc6319Ff5af8f:YOURSIGNATURE
    req.headers["x-signature"] = \`\${PUBLIC_KEY}:\${signature}\`

    // Verify your signature (might be needed when testing)
    const publicKey = ethers.utils.verifyMessage("dexalot", signature);

Python Example:

    account = Account.from_key(private_key=PRIVATE_KEY)
    message = encode_defunct(text="dexalot")
    signed_message = account.sign_message(signable_message=message)
    headers = {"x-signature": f"{account.address}:{signed_message.signature.hex()}}
    resp = await client.get(request_url, headers=headers)

You may also use https://etherscan.io/verifiedSignatures to generate the signature and provide it to your bots as a configuration.

After generating the signature a typical signed endpoint request would look like:

curl --location 'https://api.dexalot-test.com/privapi/signed/portfoliobalance' \\
--header 'x-signature: {0xTraderAddress}:{SignatureHash}'

Note: Please keep in mind that the orders are retrieved from our database for speed. Hence there could be some delays between the orderâs blockchain state and Dexalot db state. Always check the latest status of your orders with the tradePairs contract call TradePairs.getOrder(bytes32 _orderId) in the Contract Invocation Section
